entities.name: Vendilion clique
entities.description: A unified trio of fae triplets serving Oona and then Maralen, broken apart by the war between them.

entities.name: Iliona
entities.description: The eldest of the Vendilion triplets and clique-prime, who sides with Maralen and kills Veesa.

entities.name: Veesa
entities.description: A Vendilion sister who is lured back to Oona's service and killed by Iliona.

entities.name: Endry
entities.description: The youngest Vendilion triplet, loyal to the sapling, who survives Oona's counterattack and chooses not to wake after finding his sisters dead.

entities.name: Oona
entities.description: The faerie queen who created the Vendilion siblings and Maralen and is destroyed at Glen Elendra.

entities.name: Maralen
entities.description: A strange elf woman who is a byproduct of Oona's tampering and whom the clique comes to serve.

entities.name: Ashling
entities.description: A flamekin pilgrim whom the clique rescues and later helps destroy Oona.

entities.name: Rhys
entities.description: A Gilt-Leaf exile who travels with Ashling and helps destroy Oona.

entities.name: Brigid Baeli
entities.description: A kithkin whom Endry is sent to save from Gilt-Leaf hunters.

entities.name: Colfenor
entities.description: A treefolk sage whose plots to undermine Oona the clique spies on.

entities.name: Sygg
entities.description: A ferry captain on the Merrow Lanes.

entities.name: Gryffid
entities.description: A Gilt-Leaf leader who vanishes in a fog summoned by Maralen.

entities.name: The Sapling
entities.description: A sapling born of Colfenor, loved by Endry, killed by Oona.

entities.name: Rosheen Meanderer
entities.description: A great giant sage contacted via the clique's dream magic.

entities.name: Lorwyn
entities.description: The plane where the Vendilion clique lives.

entities.name: Glen Elendra
entities.description: Oona's haven where Maralen is taken and Oona is destroyed.

entities.name: Cayr Ulios
entities.description: The site of the final battle of the fae.

entities.name: Great Aurora
entities.description: The event whose approach drives Oona's creation of the Vendilion siblings.

entities.name: Battle of Cayr Ulios
entities.description: The fae battle begun when Iliona impales Veesa.

events.summary: Oona creates the Vendilion siblings in the final days before the Great Aurora.
events.quote: The Vendilion siblings were created by the Great Mother Oona in the final days before the Great Aurora

events.summary: Endry awakens and the three unite into the clique, leaving Oona's haven to explore Lorwyn.
events.quote: the clique left Oona's haven to face and enjoy Lorwyn together

events.summary: The triplets meet Ashling on a ferry and save the passengers from an arbomander.
events.quote: They saved her and the other passengers when the ferry was attacked by an arbomander

events.summary: The clique secretly spies on Rhys, Brigid and Maralen and reports to Oona.
events.quote: the trio was, in actuality, secretly spying on them and reporting their movements to Oona

events.summary: The clique lulls the party to sleep to read their thoughts but cannot breach Maralen's mind.
events.quote: He found her mind impregnably guarded and her secrets unreachable

events.summary: The clique whisks Maralen away to Glen Elendra as a gift to Oona.
events.quote: the siblings had whisked her away to Glen Elendra as a gift to their queen.

events.summary: The clique learns Maralen is a faerie duplicate and begins to obey her.
events.quote: the clique was informed then of Maralen's origins as a faerie duplicate

events.summary: The fae overwhelm Gilt-Leaf forces pursuing Rhys, and Maralen makes Gryffid and the rangers vanish in fog.
events.quote: the rest of the Gilt-Leaf rangers and their leader Gryffid simply vanished in a haze of fog

events.summary: Endry is sent to save Brigid and then guide the sapling while his sisters serve Maralen.
events.quote: Endry was dispatched to save Brigid Baeli from Gilt-Leaf hunters

events.summary: Endry's mushroom ring lets Maralen divert energy from Ashling's ritual.
events.quote: Endry's mushroom faerie ring planted at the sapling's body allowed Maralen to divert a part of the energy from Ashling's ritual for herself.

events.summary: Oona lures Veesa back into her service, shattering the clique.
events.quote: Later, Oona managed to lure Veesa back into her service, shattering the clique completely.

events.summary: Iliona impales Veesa with her crystal sword, starting the Battle of Cayr Ulios.
events.quote: Iliona replied by impaling Veesa with her crystal sword, effectively starting the Battle of Cayr Ulios.

events.summary: Oona kills the sapling and the groundlings; Endry survives losing a wing.
events.quote: Oona unleashed a counterattack, killing the sapling by cutting her in two with a thornvine

events.summary: Maralen, Rhys and Ashling destroy Oona.
events.quote: destroyed Oona by a combination of poison, fire, and water magic.

events.summary: Endry finds his sisters dead and decides never to wake.
events.quote: he decided not to wake up, ever.
